## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `stig-compliance` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Implemented and conformance-gated.** The `stig-compliance` adapter is wired into the UIAO_121 automated conformance runner and currently clears **21/21 Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria** (`tests/test_adapter_conformance.py`, CI-gated via `adapter-conformance.yml`). Tiers 2–3 (provenance/evidence and live integration) remain pending.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `xccdf-results`, `stig-benchmark-summaries`, `stig-to-nist-cci-mappings`

**Validation artifacts:** `findings.json`, `metadata.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/stig-compliance/stig-compliance.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `CM-6`, `CM-7`, `CA-7`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **CM-6** Configuration Settings | Primary | STIG rule evaluation verifies configuration settings against DISA-published baselines per platform — the canonical evidence for configuration hardening compliance. |
| **CM-7** Least Functionality | Supporting | STIG rules include least-functionality checks (disabled services, removed packages, restricted features); failures surface as least-functionality findings. |
| **CA-7** Continuous Monitoring | Supporting | Scheduled STIG assessment provides continuous compliance posture evidence with the freshness-window semantics defined in canon. |
